REM-SSH-01.objective: Enforce SSHv2 and strong crypto on FortiOS
REM-SSH-01.cli_command:
config system global
    set admin-ssh-v1 disable
    set strong-crypto enable
    set admin-ssh-port 22
end
REM-SSH-01.before_example:
config system global
    set admin-ssh-v1 enable
end
REM-SSH-01.after_example:
config system global
    set admin-ssh-v1 disable
    set strong-crypto enable
end
REM-SSH-01.rollback_command:
config system global
    set admin-ssh-v1 enable
end
REM-SSH-01.explanation: Disables SSH version 1 and enables high-assurance cryptographic algorithms.

REM-TELNET-01.objective: Remove Telnet from administrative access on FortiOS interfaces
REM-TELNET-01.cli_command:
config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
    next
end
REM-TELNET-01.before_example: set allowaccess ping https ssh telnet http
REM-TELNET-01.rollback_command:
config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set allowaccess ping https ssh telnet
    next
end
REM-TELNET-01.explanation: Strips cleartext telnet from listening interface services.

REM-HTTP-01.objective: Disable HTTP administrative access on FortiOS interfaces
REM-HTTP-01.cli_command:
config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
    next
end
config system global
    set admin-sport 443
    set admin-port 8080
end
REM-HTTP-01.before_example: set allowaccess ping http https ssh
REM-HTTP-01.rollback_command:
config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set allowaccess ping https ssh http
    next
end
REM-HTTP-01.explanation: Restricts web GUI access exclusively to encrypted HTTPS.

REM-HTTPS-01.objective: Enforce TLS 1.2/1.3 and HTTPS web management on FortiOS
REM-HTTPS-01.cli_command:
config system global
    set ssl-min-proto-version tls1-2
    set ssl-static-key-ciphers disable
    set admin-https-redirect enable
end
REM-HTTPS-01.after_example:
set ssl-min-proto-version tls1-2
set admin-https-redirect enable
REM-HTTPS-01.rollback_command:
config system global
    set ssl-min-proto-version default
end
REM-HTTPS-01.explanation: Mandates TLS 1.2 as lowest acceptable cipher version and redirects port 80 to 443.

REM-SNMP-01.objective: Configure SNMPv3 with authPriv and delete community strings on FortiOS
REM-SNMP-01.cli_command:
config system snmp community
    delete 1
end
config system snmp user
    edit "secadmin"
        set status enable
        set trap-status enable
        set auth-proto sha256
        set auth-pwd "AuthPass2026!"
        set priv-proto aes256
        set priv-pwd "PrivPass2026!"
        set security-level auth-priv
    next
end
REM-SNMP-01.before_example:
config system snmp community
    edit 1
        set name "public"
REM-SNMP-01.after_example:
config system snmp user
    edit "secadmin"
        set security-level auth-priv ...
REM-SNMP-01.rollback_command:
config system snmp user
    delete "secadmin"
end
REM-SNMP-01.explanation: Creates hardened SNMPv3 user profile with SHA-256 HMAC and AES-256 encryption.

REM-LOG-01.objective: Configure centralized remote Syslog daemon on FortiOS
REM-LOG-01.cli_command:
config log syslogd setting
    set status enable
    set server "10.100.20.50"
    set mode udp
    set port 514
    set facility local7
    set format rfc5424
end
REM-LOG-01.before_example:
config log syslogd setting
    set status disable
end
REM-LOG-01.after_example:
config log syslogd setting
    set status enable
    set server "10.100.20.50"
    set format rfc5424
end
REM-LOG-01.rollback_command:
config log syslogd setting
    set status disable
end
REM-LOG-01.explanation: Enables remote syslog forwarding using RFC 5424 structured headers.

REM-NTP-01.objective: Configure authoritative NTP time servers on FortiOS
REM-NTP-01.cli_command:
config system ntp
    set ntpsync enable
    set type custom
    set syncinterval 60
    config ntpserver
        edit 1
            set server "10.100.10.10"
        next
        edit 2
            set server "10.100.10.11"
        next
    end
end
REM-NTP-01.before_example:
config system ntp
    set ntpsync disable
end
REM-NTP-01.after_example:
config system ntp
    set ntpsync enable
    set type custom
    config ntpserver ...
REM-NTP-01.rollback_command:
config system ntp
    set ntpsync disable
end
REM-NTP-01.explanation: Enables clock synchronization against private enterprise time servers.

REM-AAA-01.objective: Configure TACACS+ / RADIUS centralized authentication on FortiOS
REM-AAA-01.cli_command:
config user tacacs+
    edit "TACACS-SRV"
        set server "10.100.30.15"
        set key "C1ph3rX!S3cur3K3y"
        set authorization enable
    next
end
config user group
    edit "SEC-ADMINS"
        set member "TACACS-SRV"
    next
end
REM-AAA-01.explanation: Integrates FortiGate administrative access with enterprise TACACS+ cluster.

REM-PASS-01.objective: Enforce 15-character minimum password policy on FortiOS
REM-PASS-01.cli_command:
config system password-policy
    set status enable
    set min-length 15
    set min-lower-case-letter 1
    set min-upper-case-letter 1
    set min-non-alphanumeric 1
    set min-number 1
    set expire-status enable
    set expire-day 90
end
REM-PASS-01.before_example:
config system password-policy
    set status disable
end
REM-PASS-01.after_example:
config system password-policy
    set status enable
    set min-length 15
end
REM-PASS-01.rollback_command:
config system password-policy
    set status disable
end
REM-PASS-01.explanation: Enforces 15-character threshold and 4-way character complexity rules.

REM-TIMEOUT-01.objective: Set administrative session idle timeout to 10 minutes on FortiOS
REM-TIMEOUT-01.cli_command:
config system global
    set admintimeout 10
end
REM-TIMEOUT-01.before_example:
config system global
    set admintimeout 30
end
REM-TIMEOUT-01.after_example:
config system global
    set admintimeout 10
end
REM-TIMEOUT-01.rollback_command:
config system global
    set admintimeout 30
end
REM-TIMEOUT-01.explanation: Terminates inactive GUI and CLI administrator sessions after 10 minutes.

REM-CRYPTO-01.objective: Enforce strong cryptography across all FortiOS subsystems
REM-CRYPTO-01.cli_command:
config system global
    set strong-crypto enable
    set ssl-static-key-ciphers disable
    set ssl-min-proto-version tls1-2
end
REM-CRYPTO-01.rollback_command:
config system global
    set strong-crypto disable
end
REM-CRYPTO-01.explanation: Prohibits weak ciphers across web administration, SSH, and TLS proxy engines.

REM-UNUSED-01.objective: Disable unused discovery and telemetry services on FortiOS
REM-UNUSED-01.cli_command:
config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set lldp-reception disable
        set lldp-transmission disable
    next
end
REM-UNUSED-01.rollback_command:
config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set lldp-transmission enable
    next
end

REM-MGMT-01.objective: Dedicate interface to management VDOM / subnet on FortiOS
REM-MGMT-01.cli_command:
config system interface
    edit "mgmt"
        set dedicated-to management
        set ip 192.168.100.2 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
    next
end
REM-MGMT-01.rollback_command:
config system interface
    edit "mgmt"
        set dedicated-to none
    next
end
REM-MGMT-01.explanation: Isolates administrative traffic to dedicated out-of-band management port.

REM-ACL-01.objective: Ensure explicit default drop rule in firewall policy chain on FortiOS
REM-ACL-01.cli_command:
config firewall policy
    edit 0
        set name "DEFAULT-DENY-ALL"
        set srcintf "any"
        set dstintf "any"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action deny
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
    next
end
REM-ACL-01.after_example:
edit 0
    set name "DEFAULT-DENY-ALL"
    set action deny
    set logtraffic all
REM-ACL-01.explanation: Adds explicit logging deny rule at the bottom of the security policy table.

REM-FW-01.objective: Enforce stateful inspection and UTM security profiles on FortiOS policies
REM-FW-01.cli_command:
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set utm-status enable
        set ssl-ssh-profile "deep-inspection"
        set av-profile "default"
        set ips-sensor "high_security"
        set logtraffic all
    next
end
REM-FW-01.rollback_command:
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set utm-status disable
    next
end
REM-FW-01.explanation: Activates deep packet inspection, antivirus, and intrusion prevention.

REM-REMOTE-01.objective: Enforce MFA and TLS 1.3 for SSL-VPN on FortiOS
REM-REMOTE-01.cli_command:
config vpn ssl settings
    set ssl-min-proto-version tls1-2
    set ssl-max-proto-version tls1-3
    set banned-cipher SHA1 RSA
    set auth-timeout 28800
end
config user local
    edit "vpnuser1"
        set two-factor ftm
    next
end
REM-REMOTE-01.after_example:
set ssl-min-proto-version tls1-2
set two-factor ftm
REM-REMOTE-01.rollback_command:
config vpn ssl settings
    set ssl-min-proto-version default
end
REM-REMOTE-01.explanation: Binds FortiToken MFA and TLS 1.2+ to remote access VPN gateway.

REM-AUTH-01.objective: Configure administrator login lockout after 3 failed attempts on FortiOS
REM-AUTH-01.cli_command:
config system global
    set admin-lockout-threshold 3
    set admin-lockout-duration 300
end
REM-AUTH-01.rollback_command:
config system global
    set admin-lockout-threshold 0
end
REM-AUTH-01.explanation: Locks out administrative accounts for 5 minutes after 3 consecutive failed logins.

REM-AUTHZ-01.objective: Configure restricted administrative access profiles on FortiOS
REM-AUTHZ-01.cli_command:
config system accprofile
    edit "SOC-ANALYST"
        set logview read
        set sysgrp none
        set netgrp read
        set fwgrp read
    next
end
REM-AUTHZ-01.before_example: ! super_admin profile used for all staff
REM-AUTHZ-01.explanation: Enforces least-privilege role boundaries for operations staff.

REM-ROUTING-01.objective: Configure BGP MD5 neighbor authentication on FortiOS
REM-ROUTING-01.cli_command:
config router bgp
    config neighbor
        edit "192.168.1.1"
            set password "ENC C1ph3rX!BGP2026"
        next
    end
end
REM-ROUTING-01.rollback_command:
config router bgp
    config neighbor
        edit "192.168.1.1"
            unset password
        next
    end
end
REM-ROUTING-01.explanation: Secures BGP TCP socket with MD5 digest.

REM-IFSEC-01.objective: Enable BPDU guard and port security on FortiSwitch interfaces
REM-IFSEC-01.cli_command:
config switch-controller managed-switch
    edit "FSW-01"
        config ports
            edit "port1"
                set stp-bpdu-guard enable
                set port-security-mode mac-limit
                set port-security-mac-limit 2
            next
        end
    next
end
REM-IFSEC-01.after_example:
set stp-bpdu-guard enable
set port-security-mode mac-limit
REM-IFSEC-01.explanation: Guards edge ports against unauthorized switches and MAC spoofing.
